name: gateway-slack
description: Slack gateway. `send` posts via Web API chat.postMessage. `start`/`stop` (Socket Mode / Events HTTP) not yet implemented.

commands.start: Start the gateway (Socket Mode / Events HTTP) (NOT IMPLEMENTED)
commands.stop: Stop a running gateway service (NOT IMPLEMENTED)
commands.send: Send a message to a channel via Slack Web API (positional: channel_id text)
